notes.title: Communication with the developer
notes.content: Welcome to the Cave Dweller discussion! Here, you can ask questions about the game, find out details, and discuss everything related to Cave Dweller. As the developer, I will try to answer all your questions and provide you with all the necessary information. Your opinion is very important to me, so please feel free to share your thoughts and ideas. Together, let's make Cave Dweller even better!
